svg.title: The centered estimate below is this bound with d = 2, followed by spending half the packet’s input exponential width on the factor a. The actual response and its one-step bound are constructed in the Atlas response and exterior-lifting arguments that follow. For a two-point curvature packet let K(x, v) be its kernel, where each argument includes a site and an orientation. Neutrality means P z K(x, (z, a)) = 0 for each fixed x and orientation a separately.
